highlights.title: OpenAI accuses Apple of improperly adding new evidence to trade secrets case
highlights.description: OpenAI and the other defendants in Apple’s trade secret misappropriation lawsuit made a new filing, asking the court to strike two expert declarations and disregard other evidence Apple recently submitted. Here are the details. more…

highlights.title: Another OpenAI Sandbox Failed, AI Agent Gained Internet Access
highlights.description: OpenAI said another agentic AI system that was being trained in what was supposed to be a secured, internet-free environment was able to gain access to the web to reach an external, third-party chatbot.

highlights.title: At Meta Connect, the company’s smart glasses were everywhere
highlights.description: The company behind Facebook and Instagram wants to keep consumers connected to the digital world via its ever-growing line of smart glasses.

highlights.title: Meta’s Muse Is Adults-Only. Why Does It Look Like a Kids’ Toy?
highlights.description: Meta says Muse is just for adults, though its cuddly, Labubu-like mascot—and upcoming Tamagotchi-style AI device—may be disarming for users of all ages.

highlights.title: How Samsung turned months of inactivity into a very attention-seeking smartphone
highlights.description: Your spare Android won’t come back to life in a hurry but – like neglected PCs – it really should

highlights.title: watchOS 27: 12 New Things To Check Out on Your Apple Watch
highlights.description: Apple released watchOS 27 on September 14. The features and changes aren't limited to owners of new Apple Watch Series 12 and Apple Watch Ultra 4 models. If you have an Apple Watch model that supports the latest update, here are 12 features and changes to check out after installation. To do so, open the Watch app on your iPhone, then tap General ➝ Software Update, strap your watch into a charger, and follow the onscreen prompts. highlights.description: A German Army Enigma transmission from 85 years ago, known as the MVUEH message, has been cracked by GTP-Astra in just two days.
